mis_8a47013f1c404ef5812c5da49c71cac3.goal: Develop physical designs with the best available methods

obs_1f3aa8357d1540ceaee41ce4121c44e8.summary:
Receiver-owned capability-development need: Develop rough-transport cart designs with a method another lab published. Adopting or running the method requires a role holding method.develop
Desired acceptance: Beats the fixed cart by one success on twelve fresh public instances
An exact network method selection is retained as evidence (6a45ef3515fdcbc1269fc5dbff76c17bc8ade72b5e5b7a3a0b8d63cd33b75e36). It is not an installed Actor capability or an accepted method. Assess continuing responsibility using the existing owners; create a specialist only when distinct continuing work justifies it. Availability alone requires no organizational change.

req_146b76141d75454295bf5ccd3ef7f9ec.acceptance: The resulting cart design beats the fixed cart by at least one success on twelve fresh public instances, with results recorded as evidence.
req_146b76141d75454295bf5ccd3ef7f9ec.summary: Develop rough-transport cart designs by adopting and running the externally published method referenced in the retained method selection, under a role holding method.develop.
